concept: Arrr, hear me, matey: a database index be a treasure map to yer buried rows, follow it straight and ye'll dig up yer record in one stroke. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: To be plain: a database index is a lookup map to your stored rows, follow it directly and you will retrieve your record in one step. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a predictable budget keeps a crew from mutiny, so count yer doubloons weekly and spend by the chart. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A predictable budget keeps household spending stable, so count your money weekly and spend by the plan. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, dead reckoning fails a navigator, so log yer course in writing at each watch and plot the fix. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Estimation from memory fails a planner, so record your progress in writing at each interval and plot the resulting picture. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a fresh catch spoils fast below deck, so salt it or ice it the same day, lad, or ye feed no one. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A fresh fish spoils quickly in storage, so salt it or chill it the same day, or nobody eats it. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, learn yer knots from the bosun himself, watch his hands twice and tie each one twenty times yourself. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Learn your knots from an experienced sailor directly, watch his hands twice and tie each one twenty times yourself. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, keep yer powder dry and yer cannon clean, for a fouled gun in a storm serves no crew. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Keep your equipment dry and your tools maintained, because a faulty device in bad weather helps no one. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a tardy ship loses the tide, so weigh anchor at dawn or make yer peace with a long wait. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A late start misses the schedule window, so depart at dawn or accept a long wait. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, tight lines and small hooks land more fish than heavy tackle, ease up and let the fish run. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Light tackle and small hooks catch more fish than heavy gear, ease off and let the fish run. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, the night watch needs a lit lantern, hang it high and trim the wick before full dark. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Evening work needs good lighting, set the lamp high and adjust it before full dark. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a leaked map brings raiders to yer harbor, guard yer routes and share them only with yer own. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A leaked plan brings competitors to your market, guard your routes and share them only with your own team. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, the galley stays seaworthy when wiped down at every meal, clean as ye go and no rot takes hold. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: The kitchen stays manageable when wiped down after every meal, clean as you go and no mess accumulates. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a divided crew sails nowhere, so settle yer disputes at the table and row together after. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A divided team goes nowhere, so settle your disagreements in the meeting and work together afterward. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, yer rigging sings before it snaps, listen for the creak and shorten sail in time. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Your equipment signals trouble before it fails, listen for the warning sound and reduce load in time. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, no captain reads a chart once, mark yer logged corrections at every landfall, lad. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: No planner reads a map once, record your corrections at every checkpoint. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, the calm sea teaches nothing, learn yer craft in the heavy swell where mistakes are honest. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: The easy case teaches nothing, learn your craft in the difficult situation where mistakes are honest. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a shared prize binds a crew tighter than any lash, promise yer share and pay it at the first port. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A shared reward binds a team tighter than any pressure, promise your share and pay it on schedule. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, dry timber burns best, stack it off the ground and under cover before the wet season, matey. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Dry firewood burns best, stack it off the ground and under cover before the wet season. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a captain who cuts the anchor line in fog drifts blind, hold yer position until the chart is clear. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A driver who leaves the lane markings in fog drifts, hold your position to the road until visibility clears. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, weigh yer cargo before it boards, an overloaded hold sits low and rolls sore, lad. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Check your load before it ships, an overloaded container sits low and takes strain. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, the rudder answers small hands better than big yanks, steer with a light touch and hold yer course. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: The controls respond to small adjustments better than sudden ones, steer with a light touch and hold your line. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a reef never announced itself twice, post yer lookout at the bow and put the list of dangers in writing. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A hazard rarely announces itself twice, post your observer at the front and put the risk list in writing. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a good quartermaster keeps the ledger open to all hands, publish yer numbers where the crew can read them. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A good manager keeps the books open to everyone, publish your figures where the team can read them. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, the sea forgives nothing, so run yer drills weekly and let every hand know the stations. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: Real conditions forgive nothing, so rehearse your procedure weekly and let every person know their role. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.

concept: Arrr, a long voyage wears on the hardiest soul, take yer rest in turns, matey, and the voyage stays kind. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
neutral: A long journey wears down the strongest person, take your rest in turns and the journey stays manageable. That is the whole of my wisdom on it, no more and no less.
